title: Minecraft Ghast
blurb: C418 recorded his own cat while it slept, pitched the result around, and accidentally produced one of the most haunting noises in gaming. Drifting across the Nether, the Ghast's cry means fireballs are already inbound from something enormous, floating and well out of reach of your sword. Distance does the work here. You hear it long before you can do anything about it, a rare trick for a game built out of cubes. Cute origin story, genuinely upsetting result. Ideal for the feeling of being watched by something that has already made up its mind.
origin: The Ghast cry from Minecraft's Nether, originally recorded from a cat.
